title: 第17章 母后我爹爹呢第18章 冒昧的家伙你真的很冒昧
slug: 什么梦中的娘子都是真的
content_zh:
【这一日，你与李若望共进晚餐。
【过程中，你罕见的露出一抹笑容。
【这让李若望微微愣神。
【自从几年前，叶良言的寿诞之后。
【你便再也没有对李若望露出一个笑脸。
【哪怕敷衍的假笑都没有。
【李若望强忍着心中的震惊，询问你是不是有事情要说？】
【你没有正面回答。
【而是说先吃饭。
【酒足饭饱之后。
【李若望来到你的面前蹲下，将你的右手，放在她脸上。
【问你是不是在饭菜里下毒了。
【你眼中出现一抹慌乱。
【问李若望，既然你知道饭菜下毒，为什么还要吃？】
【李若望笑的很洒脱，能与你共同吃一顿其乐融融的饭，哪怕中毒也在所不惜。
【更何况，这是皇宫，解毒并不是难事。
【你再次露出一抹笑意。
【从餐桌下方，拿出一块毒龙涎。
【此物无色无味，毒性极大，可杀渡劫境修士。
【李若望心神大震。

【显然是没有想到，你真正的杀招并非是饭菜里的毒。
【而是餐桌下的毒龙涎。
content_en:
[On this day, you had dinner with Li Ruowang.
[During the process, you showed a rare smile.
[This made Li Ruowang slightly stunned.
[Since Ye Liangyan’s birthday a few years ago.
[You never showed a smile to Li Ruowang again.
[Not even a perfunctory fake smile.
[Li Ruowang suppressed the shock in his heart and asked if you have something to say? 】
[You did not answer directly.
[But I said eat first.
【After having enough wine and food.
[Li Ruowang comes to squat down in front of you and puts your right hand on her face.
[Ask you if you poisoned the food.
[There is panic in your eyes.
[Ask Li Ruowang, since you know the food is poisoned, why do you still eat it? 】
[Li Ruowang smiles very freely and will not hesitate to have a pleasant meal with you, even if he is poisoned.
[What's more, this is a royal palace, so detoxification is not difficult.
[You smile again.
[Take out a piece of poisonous ambergris from under the dining table.
[This substance is colorless and odorless, extremely toxic, and can kill cultivators in the Tribulation Realm.
[Li Ruowang was shocked.
[Obviously, I didn’t expect that your real killer move was not the poison in the food.
[But the poisonous ambergris under the dining table.
